title: A focused launcher run whose quoted --test-name-pattern contains `|` is recorded Unknown ("compound command validation rejected"): a quoted pipe is treated as a pipeline
outcome: Commands containing | remain fail-closed when recorded shell context cannot prove argument containment. The existing refusal explains that verification was not credited and gives supported alternatives without echoing arguments; execution outcome stays separate from credit eligibility. Preserve normal pipe-free recording and all existing guards.
acceptance: Commands containing `|` whose containment is unsupported remain ineligible for passing verification credit. They expose the actionable, safely redacted reason at the existing refusal surface: verification not credited because the command contains `|` and its quoting cannot be safely classified from the recorded shell context; use a supported test filter without `|`, or run the alternatives separately as independent test commands.
Actual pipelines and all existing compound/unsupported forms remain fail-closed, including mixed quoted/unquoted pipes.
Otherwise supported pipe-free commands keep normal passed/failed recording, and any suggested separate invocation is assessed independently under the existing recognition rules.

The exact-input full gate, an independent review pair and a fresh acceptance evaluation precede completion and landing; R1/R2/R3 and historical failure evidence are kept. Integrate only after the queued caret-refusal fix has landed.
